about: Fix it's failure signatures: what a Proton log shows when a game fails in a common way, and the fixes for each, best first. Written for OrielOS from Proton's, DXVK's and VKD3D-Proton's own log messages. A signature with 'when' applies only while that Game Settings switch is on. Fix kinds: tool (run the game with that compatibility tool; an empty value is Steam's default), variable (add NAME=value to the launch options), turn-off (turn a Game Settings switch off), clear-shader-cache (move the game's shader cache aside), advice (something only the user can do).

signatures.cause: Wine's Wayland driver, which the HDR switch turns on, failed in this game.

fixes.explanation: Turn off HDR for this game, so it uses the usual driver.

signatures.cause: gamescope, which runs the game in its own window, couldn't start.

fixes.explanation: Turn off gamescope for this game.

signatures.cause: The newer DLSS files the DLSS upgrade adds don't work with this game.

fixes.explanation: Turn off the DLSS upgrade, so the game uses the DLSS files it came with.

signatures.cause: The game's DirectX 12 graphics couldn't start.

fixes.explanation: Turn off DX12 descriptor heaps for this game.
Run the game with Proton Experimental, which has the newest DirectX 12 fixes.

signatures.cause: The game's DirectX 9, 10 or 11 graphics couldn't start, because Vulkan didn't.

fixes.explanation: Use Wine's own DirectX instead of DXVK for this game. It's slower, but doesn't need Vulkan.
Run the game with Proton Experimental.

signatures.cause: The game's saved shaders are damaged.

fixes.explanation: Move the game's saved shaders aside, so Steam builds them again. The first few minutes may stutter.

signatures.cause: The game's videos, such as its intro or cutscenes, use a format Proton couldn't play.

fixes.explanation: Run the game with GE-Proton, which plays more video formats.
Run the game with Proton Experimental.

signatures.cause: The game's anti-cheat, Easy Anti-Cheat, stopped it.

fixes.explanation: In Steam, check that Proton EasyAntiCheat Runtime is installed: search for it in your library, under Tools. If the game's publisher hasn't allowed Linux, nothing on this PC can change that.

signatures.cause: The game's anti-cheat, BattlEye, stopped it.

fixes.explanation: In Steam, check that Proton BattlEye Runtime is installed: search for it in your library, under Tools. If the game's publisher hasn't allowed Linux, nothing on this PC can change that.

signatures.cause: A file the game needs is missing.
patterns: err:module:import_dll Library \S+ \(which is needed by .*\) not found

fixes.explanation: In Steam, right-click the game, choose Properties, then Installed Files, then Verify integrity of game files.
Run the game with GE-Proton, which includes more of Windows' own files.

signatures.cause: The game crashed as it started.

fixes.explanation: Run the game with Proton Experimental, which has the newest fixes.
Run the game with GE-Proton, which has fixes for many games.
Run the game with Steam's own choice of Proton.
